protocol.description:
This protocol lets a client hand the animation of a subsurface's transform and opacity to the compositor. The client describes where a property should go and the spring that takes it there; the compositor evaluates the spring on every output frame and draws the subsurface accordingly, so the client does not have to render a new buffer for every frame of the motion.
Springs are closed-form damped harmonic oscillators described by a response (the period of the undamped oscillation, in seconds) and a damping ratio (1 is critically damped, below 1 overshoots). Client and compositor evaluate the same formula from the same start time, so a client can predict exactly where the compositor draws the surface at any instant.
Warning! The protocol described in this file is currently in the testing phase. Backward compatible changes may be added together with the corresponding interface version bump. Backward incompatible changes can only be done by creating a new major version of the extension.

interface.name: crownos_surface_animation_manager_v1
interface.description: A global factory for crownos_animated_surface_v1 objects.

entry.name: not_subsurface
entry.summary: the surface does not have the wl_subsurface role

entry.name: already_animated
entry.summary: the surface already has an animated surface object

request.name: destroy
request.description: Destroy the manager. Objects created through it are unaffected.

request.name: get_animated_surface
request.description:
Create an animated surface object for a subsurface.
The surface must already have the wl_subsurface role, otherwise the not_subsurface protocol error is raised. A surface can have at most one animated surface object at a time; asking for a second one raises the already_animated protocol error.

interface.name: crownos_animated_surface_v1
interface.description:
Animates the transform and opacity of one subsurface.
Every request is double-buffered: it takes effect on the next wl_surface.commit of the subsurface, which follows the usual synchronized or desynchronized subsurface rules.
The transform is applied on top of the position set through wl_subsurface.set_position: the surface is scaled and rotated about its own center, then translated. Child subsurfaces inherit the transform and the opacity of their parent.
If the wl_surface is destroyed, this object becomes inert.

entry.name: invalid_spring
entry.summary: response is not positive or damping ratio is negative

enum.name: property
enum.description: The properties a client can animate, with the value each one rests at when it was never set.

entry.name: translate_x
entry.summary: horizontal offset in surface-local coordinates, rests at 0

entry.name: translate_y
entry.summary: vertical offset in surface-local coordinates, rests at 0

entry.name: scale
entry.summary: uniform scale about the surface center, rests at 1

entry.name: rotation
entry.summary: clockwise rotation in degrees about the surface center, rests at 0

entry.name: opacity
entry.summary: opacity multiplier between 0 and 1, rests at 1

request.name: destroy
request.description: Destroy the object. On the next commit every property returns to its resting value and running animations stop without a settled event.

request.name: animate

description.summary: spring a property toward a target

request.description:
Animate a property toward target with a spring.
The animation starts at start_time, a CLOCK_MONOTONIC timestamp in microseconds split into its high and low 32 bits. A start time of 0 means the moment the compositor applies the commit.
If the property is already animating, the new animation continues from the value and velocity the running one has at start_time, and the interrupted event reports them. Otherwise it starts from the current value at rest.
The compositor sends settled once the property reaches target and stops moving.

arg.name: response_seconds
arg.summary: period of the undamped oscillation, must be positive

arg.name: damping_ratio
arg.summary: 1 is critically damped, below 1 overshoots, must not be negative

request.name: set

description.summary: jump a property to a value

request.description: Set a property to value immediately, cancelling any animation of it without an event.

event.name: settled
event.description: The animation of property reached its target and stopped moving. value is where it came to rest.

event.name: interrupted
event.description: A new animate request replaced a running animation of property. value and velocity (units per second) are the state the replaced animation had at the new animation's start time, which is where the new one continues from.
